slots.roadmap-interval-variant/title: The roadmap advances only when evidence and operational readiness support it
slots.roadmap-interval-variant/sequence-explan: Discovery and definition occupy illustrative weeks 1–4; build and prove weeks 5–10; pilot and adapt weeks 11–14; scale and transition weeks 15–20.
slots.roadmap-interval-variant/date-qualificat: Timeline is illustrative, not a committed delivery date.
slots.roadmap-interval-variant/readiness/conte: Mobilization readiness depends on sponsors, owners, data access, sample availability, security contacts, and a first journey hypothesis.
Access delays, unremediated source data, vendor constraints, or material control changes can move the sequence.
slots.roadmap-interval-variant/pilot-gate/cont: Proceed to pilot only after owners accept test evidence, critical control findings are resolved, operations can execute runbooks, and rollback is rehearsed.
Additional journeys, integrations, and operating hours require separate scope decisions.
slots.roadmap-interval-variant/expansion-gate/: Proceed to expansion only when validated baseline and pilot data support the decision; if evidence is weak or conditions change, adjust scope and retain the existing service.
No expansion decision is implied before evidence and readiness gates are met.
slots.slide/takeaway: Readiness evidence and recovery decisions control when the program advances.
